text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... Yes, I won. Right, when it 
comes to a 2000m battle of late-stage 
bursts.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—I can't give up. For the sake of myself, 
who walks alongside that girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Admire Vega. The brilliant 
finishing burst she honed alongside Narita 
Top Road clinched the victory.”

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Dotou
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Ayabe-san! Congrats to 
you~, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Top Road-san, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing Ayabe-san at this distance on 
the Tokyo Racecourse really is no easy 
feat after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"The final straight was incredible. 
Ayabe-san, you really are an Umamusume who 
never gives up."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I was an Umamusume who had 
given up on everything.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it was changed. By a certain 
someone, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That smile—seemed almost as if it were 
directed toward Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, Ayabe-san, simply magnificent! Even 
I must take off my crown for you today.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Still... a deadlock where even the 
End-of-Century Overlord can be defeated. 
It might almost be time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera-chan? What do you mean by the "right 
moment"...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, just listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the center of the four of 
them, T.M. Opera O began to speak.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Don't you all think it is about time we 
reexamine the current format of the Revue? 
Namely—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: No side! And no border, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No-border...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It all started when I evolved so 
powerfully and beautifully.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To catch up to me, Top Road-san and 
Ayabe-san joined forces, honed their 
skills, and finally reached my domain.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"With Doto joining in, they're currently 
in opposition. However――"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Inherently, there are no walls between 
us. Isn't that right? Because we are..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Because we're "classmates."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Palpitations...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. A constellation of brilliant stars 
who shared the same year beneath the very 
same sky."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And now, every star shines with equal 
brilliance. Your growth has been truly 
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And because we've made it this far, we 
should feel free to interact with each 
other even more.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Like having Top Road-san and Doto train 
alongside each other—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Even if Ayabe-san and I get super close!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I really don't like the sound of that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway! Instead of two separate duos, why 
don't we inspire and sharpen each other as 
a single quartet?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I think that way allows one to reach 
greater heights. And that—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be the best way to fire up 
our generation?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Our... generation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's remark about their 
"generation" caused massive ripples to 
spread.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the Golden Generation 
one year above them was the same...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, Spe-chan! Grass-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You two came to watch, too! I came to 
watch with King-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it was, Tsuru-chan! Yeah, 
watching races really is a lot of fun, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Don't be silly. There's no way I 
came to watch just for fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's an inspection. An inspection. We 
might end up facing each other sometime 
this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The late-blooming Umamusume of the Golden 
Generation, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi. And King 
Halo, who proudly holds up her banner of 
first-class excellence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of this sheer depth of talent, 
they were called the Golden Generation. 
Such free-spirited camaraderie was 
something Narita Top Road's generation did 
not have.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Our next race goes without saying. The GⅠ 
Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"So why don't we have a showdown for the 
lead role there? The four of us, plus our 
honored guests from around the world."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquers that race will draw 
the world's attention and simultaneously 
become— the "King of the Generation."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, Opera O-chan! Everyone 
bringing out everything they've learned so 
far—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash with all we have! Everyone is 
a friend, and everyone is a rival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two small circles became one 
big circle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this turned out to be quite 
unexpected, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A race where everyone is jumbled together 
is a little... nerve-wracking.
choice_data_list: Yeah, yesterday's friend is today's rival.

Yeah, yesterday's friend is today's rival, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Now that I think about it... I 
might have been clinging to Ayabe-san a 
bit too much lately.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We don't need to lean on each other 
anymore. They're both strong...! And both 
of them are..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We're aiming for the top! After all, only 
one person can stand at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The friendship between Umamusume is no 
ordinary friendship. It shines all the 
brighter and hotter precisely because they 
compete against each other.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! Before standing at the 
pinnacle of the Twinkle Series— first, 
I'll aim for the top of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in the Japan Cup, where 
Umamusume from all over the world gather!
